budget_items.topic: Health insurance renewal rates for active employees
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Health renewal rates for active employees were reported as a 3% increase, described as good news.
budget_items.quote: couple of pieces of good news - health renewal rates for active employees is 3%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: About $500,000 to $600,000 of CARES Act money is left, usable only for unbudgeted expenses.
budget_items.quote: between $500,000 - 600,000 is left. it can only be used for unbudgeted expenses.

budget_items.topic: DPW Fuel Tank Project unspent capital
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported about $80,000 of unspent capital remaining on the nearly complete Fuel Tank Project.
budget_items.quote: nearing completion - $80,000 of unspent capital on that project.

budget_items.topic: Flat Hill Culvert / DPW earmark and original budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The earmark was $165,000 and the original budgeted amount was $110,000 for first capital and $220,000 for second capital, with part of the increase from permitting and design work.
budget_items.quote: the earmark was $165,000 and the original budgeted amount was $110,000 first capital and $220,000 for the seconded capital.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $50,000 Capital Plan Request for Marshall Park was discussed and described as low on the priority list.
budget_items.quote: marshall park discussion - $50,000 capital plan request - which is low on the priority list.

budget_items.topic: Senior Center parking lot project withdrawn from DPW
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A parking lot project for the senior center was withdrawn at $125,000 for the area between the building and playground, pulled for a more comprehensive plan.
budget_items.quote: parking lot for the senior center - $125,000 between the building and playground.

budget_items.topic: Demolition article defeated at Town Meeting
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $400,000 demolition article brought to Town Meeting was voted down.
budget_items.quote: an article was brought to town meeting for $400,000 demolition that was voted down.

budget_items.topic: Debt limits as a percentage of town expenditures
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town debt policy caps net regular debt at 4% and excludable debt at 11%, with the aggregate no more than 14%; FY21 figures were given as shares of each cap.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Members discussed whether the TCP project would be financed by debt exclusion or the operating budget, describing it as a sizable sum, without a figure.
budget_items.quote: are we seriously considering that this project would come out of the operating budget and not a debt exclusion?
